column1: # Sweden Riksdag 2026 - per-valkrets results, ABSOLUTE counts [SOURCED] [PROVISIONAL]
#   (the official machine-readable backend of the result presentation at
#   fetched 2026-09-23 and saved byte-exact as raw/resultat_val2026_RD_{NN}_S.json (SHA-256 in
#   raw/SHA256SUMS.results.txt). Code 30 returns 404, which is itself the completeness check: Sweden has
#   exactly 29 riksdagsvalkretsar. Result fixed by Valmyndigheten's decision of 2026-09-19, Dnr VAL-735-2026.
# ALL ELEVEN COLUMN SUMS VERIFIED against the published national figures (RD_S.json and the decision's Bilaga 1):
# EVERY CELL CROSS-CHECKED TWICE MORE, independently: (1) the decision PDF's Bilaga 1 per-valkrets pages
#   (raw/beslutsprotokoll-resultat-riksdagen-2026.pdf) - party votes, valid, invalid, cast, eligible: 0 differences
#   (2) sheets Antal_valkrets and Valdeltagande_valkrets of Valmyndigheten's final-count workbook
#   votes, valid (= the sum of all 124 party columns), cast, eligible: 0 differences.
# SAME 29 UNITS AS 2022: each 2026 file carries 2022 comparison fields (antalRosterForegaendeVal,
#   antalRostberattigadeForegaendeVal) and for all 29 valkretsar they equal valkrets_votes_2022.csv exactly
#   (valid, eligible, the eight party columns) - the boundaries and names did not change.
# ROW ORDER IS THE 2022 FILE'S (itself the 2018 file's), DELIBERATELY (W-F1, R-N1): every consumer keys regions by
#   INDEX, so the repoint changes the NUMBERS and nothing else. The JSON backend's own code order differs
# COLUMNS ARE THE 2022 FILE'S EXACTLY (12 columns, same header), so a consumer repoints by changing the filename.
#   Seats per valkrets are NOT here (a 13th column would break ElectionsDataCatalogGenerator's 12-cell assertion):
# 'valid' is ROSTER SOM PAVERKAR MANDATFORDELNINGEN (rosterPaverkaMandat.antalRoster) - the count the seat
#   allocation runs on. It excludes blank and invalid ballots, so 'cast' minus 'valid' is those
#   columns do not sum to 'valid' either, because parties below the threshold ("Övriga anmälda partier", and in
#   Örebro län Örebropartiet, which the backend shows separately there) make up the remainder.
